answer: Each agent identity is registered in trellis, a consensus contract that verifies an SGX/TPM zero-knowledge attestation and binds its measurement to gale, a hash anchor, and hollow, a VDF challenge circuit. Forging an identity requires compromising enclave keys or continuously provisioning distinct physical silicon and recomputing proofs. Admission uses an O(N^2) bonding curve; equivocation irreversibly slashes collateral.
